name: MAXIMUS - Der Flug des Wachters
description: The most spectacular and historically significant roller coaster in any LEGOLAND park worldwide — MAXIMUS is a Bolliger and Mabillard Wing Coaster that opened in 2023 as the centrepiece of the brand-new LEGO MYTHICA themed world and is the only roller coaster in any LEGOLAND park anywhere in the world to feature inversions. Riders sit in wing-style seats extending either side of the track with nothing above or below them as MAXIMUS delivers two intense inversions, soaring wingover elements and dramatic near-miss moments across a spectacular themed layout dedicated to the guardian of MYTHICA. The ride reaches 90 km/h and stands nearly 30 metres tall. Min. height: 120cm with adult, 130cm alone.

name: Fire Dragon
description: The beloved classic at the heart of LEGOLAND Deutschland — Fire Dragon is a family coaster in the Knights Kingdom area that begins with a magical indoor dark ride section through the enchanted castle of the brave knights before launching riders into an exciting outdoor coaster section with a thrilling dragon flight through the medieval landscape. The perfect combination of immersive storytelling and genuine coaster excitement that has delighted LEGOLAND Deutschland families since the park opened in 2002. Min. height: 100cm with adult, 120cm alone.

name: The Great LEGO Race
description: A classic wild mouse family coaster in the LEGO X-treme zone that sends riders racing through sharp hairpin turns, sudden drops and surprising directional changes at speed. The Great LEGO Race is one of the most rerideable attractions at LEGOLAND Deutschland — compact, punchy and endlessly fun for families with children aged 6 and above. The LEGO Technic theming throughout the queue and ride area creates an immersive engineering aesthetic that appeals to LEGO fans of all ages. Min. height: 100cm.

name: Flying NINJAGO
description: A state-of-the-art motion simulator attraction in the NINJAGO World area where riders board flying vehicles and experience an immersive aerial adventure alongside the NINJAGO heroes. Flying NINJAGO uses sophisticated motion platform technology to create the convincing sensation of high-speed flight, barrel rolls and dramatic aerial manoeuvres in a fully enclosed simulator environment. Particularly popular with families who love the NINJAGO franchise. Not recommended for guests susceptible to motion sickness. Min. height: 100cm.

name: Dragon Hunt
description: An exciting indoor dark ride shooter in the Knights Kingdom area where families board cars and use laser blasters to shoot at targets throughout the elaborate medieval castle setting. Dragon Hunt challenges riders to hunt the dragon through spectacular castle chambers, dungeons and forest scenes while accumulating competitive scores — the more accurate the shooting the higher the score. Highly replayable and consistently one of the most popular family attractions at LEGOLAND Deutschland. Min. height: 90cm with adult.

name: Power Builder
description: A truly unique attraction at any theme park anywhere in the world — Power Builder lets riders programme their own robotic arm ride experience before strapping in and living it. Guests choose their own sequence of movements from a selection of options creating a personalised ride experience that is completely different from the standard theme park formula. Power Builder is one of the most technologically innovative and genuinely surprising family attractions in Germany and a major reason to visit LEGOLAND Deutschland specifically. Min. height: 100cm.

name: Jungle X-pedition
description: An exciting jeep adventure ride through the dense LEGO jungle of Adventure Land where riders board explorer vehicles and navigate through atmospheric jungle scenery filled with LEGO animals, ancient ruins and surprising interactive moments. Jungle X-pedition is one of the most immersive and atmospherically rich rides at LEGOLAND Deutschland — the dense theming and LEGO wildlife create a genuinely transportive experience for younger visitors. Min. height: 90cm with adult.

name: Captain Nick's Splash Battle
description: An interactive water ride and one of the most joyfully social attractions at LEGOLAND Deutschland — Captain Nick's Splash Battle puts riders in pirate boats equipped with water cannons and lets them drench other boats and shore-side spectators while being shot back at from water cannon stations along the route. The combination of movement, shooting and aquatic warfare creates hilarious moments of complete strangers gleefully soaking each other. Guaranteed good fun on a warm Bavarian summer day. Min. height: 90cm.

name: Aquazone Wave Racers
description: A thrilling water ride where riders board jet ski-style vehicles and race through churning waves and water jets while being soaked by interactive water cannons operated by spectators watching from the shore. Aquazone Wave Racers is one of the best-loved water attractions at LEGOLAND Deutschland — the combination of genuine excitement on the water and the participatory element of spectators controlling the soaking creates a uniquely interactive and unpredictable experience. Min. height: 100cm.

name: Pirate Land
description: The atmospheric heart of the adventure at LEGOLAND Deutschland — Pirate Land is an elaborately themed zone built around LEGO pirate ships, harbour scenes and swashbuckling seafaring atmosphere. Home to multiple pirate-themed rides and play areas including the magnificent pirate ship climbing structure, Pirate Land is the most consistently exciting and visually spectacular themed zone in the park for younger children who want to live out their LEGO pirate fantasies. Suitable for all ages.

name: Pirate School
description: A wonderful interactive experience unique to LEGOLAND Deutschland — Pirate School recruits young visitors as trainee pirates and puts them through a genuinely fun training course of swinging ropes, climbing nets, balance beams and physical challenges that develop coordination and courage in a completely safe and supervised environment. One of the most beloved and distinctively LEGOLAND experiences in the park — children who complete the course receive their official pirate certificate. Min. height: 90cm.

name: Kids Power Tower
description: A fun junior drop tower in the LEGO City area where children take control of their own ascent by pulling on a rope — the harder they pull the higher they go, before releasing and bouncing back down in a series of gentle drops. Kids Power Tower is one of the most joyfully interactive junior attractions at LEGOLAND Deutschland and teaches children the relationship between their own effort and the ride outcome in a completely safe and accessible way. Min. height: 90cm.

name: LEGO City Driving School
description: One of the most iconic and universally beloved LEGOLAND attractions — LEGO City Driving School puts children aged 6-13 behind the wheel of real battery-powered LEGO City cars on a road network complete with traffic lights, road signs and intersections. Successfully navigating the driving school earns each child an official LEGOLAND driving licence — one of the most treasured souvenirs any child can take home from a theme park visit. Consistently one of the highest-rated attractions at LEGOLAND Deutschland among families. Min. age: 6 years.

name: Airport (Flughafen)
description: A delightful classic LEGOLAND spinning plane ride where riders board rotating LEGO aeroplanes and control how high they fly by tilting a joystick during the ride. Airport is one of the most charming and timeless attractions at LEGOLAND Deutschland — simple, joyful and enduringly popular with younger visitors who love the sense of personal control over their own flight experience. Suitable for all ages.

name: Fire Academy
description: The most beloved participatory attraction at LEGOLAND Deutschland — families board fire trucks and must physically pump themselves to a blazing building by pulling on a rope, then battle the flames with water hoses while competing against other teams. The fastest team to extinguish the fire wins. Fire Academy creates genuine physical effort, family teamwork and hilarious competition that makes it one of the most memorable experiences at any LEGOLAND park. Min. height: 90cm.
